title: Yosef Sheida
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He lived in the time of Rav Chisda and Rabbah, as in [Eruvin 43a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.43a.17-18) ([Rashi there](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Eruvin.43a.18.1) explains that he does not keep Shabbat). In [Pesachim 110a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.110a.11-12), Rav Yosef said, “Yosef Sheida told me,” and Rav Papa said, “Yosef Sheida told me.” Hyman infers that he lived a long life.[^1]

notes.text: Eruvin names Rav Chisda and Rava. Hyman has Rabbah. Both reports in Pesachim say, “Yosef Sheida told me.” Hyman draws the inference about longevity from the two reports.
